priors.question: Originalidad de homogamia de deseabilidad sin preferencia inicial por semejanza
priors.rationale: La proposición general ya está en teoría matching, Hitsch 2010 y, casi literalmente para apps, Topinkova/Diviak 2025; nueva aportación exigiría predicción más estrecha. La separación de navegación, primer mensaje y match se documentó explícitamente en Hitsch et al. (2010), antes del programa ESBM. No reivindicar originalidad general de la cadena. Rios–Saban–Zheng (online 2022) probó algoritmo con exposición e historial de matches en dos intervenciones de mercado; Rios–Torrico 2023 ya formaliza secuencialidad y direcciones del flujo. ESBM no reivindica novedad de optimización de exposición y reciprocidad ni de feedback por matches. External 2024 intervention already studies a causal micro-interaction influence independent of pre-exposure sorting. ESBM has not yet included an observed micro-behavior intervention; adding smiles alone would lack originality. ICONIP 2020 MotifGNN already models reciprocal recommendation over user directed interaction graphs with degree/motif structure. Our degree-conditioned reciprocity finding does not establish a new theory: it is a data-quality/control exercise on published dataset. Su & Hu 2019 already used ratios click/rec and msg/rec as popularity and modeled target and sender attributes and network centrality; 2020 MotifGNN already modeled mutual interaction graph. N82 smooth target CTR out-of-actor predictive advantage is not a new theoretical mechanism or 2/3. Contest researchers in 2011 already studied ranking profiles by expected click/msg, including RankSVM, Bayesian Regression Trees and simple popularity voting; source 2012 participant explicitly discusses click/rec and msg utilities. A generic target-click-rate advantage N82 is not novel and must be compared against original NDCG@10 or stronger actor-target/context models before any novelty claim.

Independent historical teaching slide transcript matches precisely 8,599,012, 8,366,058 rec, 184,291 click, 48,663 msg and 59,921 users to author-released SSJY ZIP. Posthoc stronger baseline of target exposure-frequency x round groups (256 bins, smoothing 100) logloss .094492, target CTR still gains .006739, CI [.005870,.007727].
